scope: Prepare Laravel backend for accepted dashboard: browser sessions/capabilities, lookup contracts and isolated synthetic demo. No frontend, production deployment, real payment activation or AI agent.

requirements.text: HttpOnly browser sessions, CSRF and session-compatible identity/logout without widening bearer tokens
requirements.delivered: HttpOnly session login/CSRF/logout, effective identity; scoped bearer behavior preserved

requirements.text: Read-only staff dashboard permissions enforced server-side
requirements.delivered: Backend-enforced staff session read-only including preview and token issuance; token role/scope ceilings remain enforced

requirements.text: Paginated customer/subscription/invoice discovery and next-charge contract
requirements.delivered: Paginated authorized discovery/search and scheduled recurring base estimate

requirements.text: Per-visitor demo identities, prepared scenarios, role switch/reset, TTL/cap/prune and no real gateway
requirements.delivered: Generation-scoped visitor profiles/scenarios/reset, expiry/cap/pruning and dedicated env gates

requirements.text: Simulated pending/declined/approved outcomes respect invoice eligibility and independent state
requirements.delivered: Pending/declined/approved simulation via normal billing with no live gateway; initial/adjustment state stays independent

requirements.text: Automatic jobs/risk exclude demo data and cannot cross reset generations
requirements.delivered: Automated invoice/subscription/risk work excludes all demo generations; no queued demo lifecycle work
evidence: automated() scopes, job guards and listener shouldQueue

requirements.text: OpenAPI, docs and meaningful regression/static checks plus independent review
requirements.delivered: OpenAPI/docs complete; full runtime/coverage/static/schema/HTTP checks passed; independent review approved after corrections

spec.permissions: Session staff read-only including preview writes; customers owned data; token scopes preserved; no raw session credential in JS
spec.isolation: Dedicated demo environment; workspace foreign keys on users/customers, server authorization boundary; generation replaced on reset; automatic jobs exclude demo data; synthetic fixtures only
spec.defaults: Configurable 60 minute absolute workspace TTL and 100 workspace hard cap; demo is off by default and requires APP_ENV=demo, fake gateway, risk disabled and no InfinitePay secrets; numerical defaults are implementation assumptions not new product policy
spec.outputs: API/session endpoints, migrations, authorization, simulated payment adapter, lookups, OpenAPI/docs and regression checks
spec.acceptance: Session CSRF/login/logout works, direct staff writes denied, scopes/ownership intact; two visitors isolated through reset and queued jobs; no demo route reachable outside demo mode; required quality gates and independent review

validation.check: Full Pest suite, direct runner with PostgreSQL17/Redis7 and Xdebug coverage
OpenAPI 3.1 validator and runtime route/security contract
Production image / dedicated Compose / real HTTP
validation.result: passed: non-root boot; two independent cookie jars; CSRF; scopes; staff read-only; payment; profile/reset/replay/logout
passed: local .env readiness, production injected key/cache, demo env-only boot and missing-key refusal
23 failures due to absent Redis/pricing; rerun checks use dedicated isolated services, no application failure suppressed
64 local links valid;65 changed/new files scanned; no private-key/GitHub/AWS/GitLab credential patterns

reviews.initial: Two material blockers: non-root demo startup and rollback isolation loss
reviews.final: Both corrected with matching regressions. All seven requirements covered; no remaining material findings. Reviewer independently checked diff integrity; runtime totals are executor evidence.

corrections.cause: Demo APP_ENV was treated as development by entrypoint
corrections.fix: Production-style injected key/config/routes/events for demo, no .env creation/seeding
corrections.prevention: Entrypoint regression and fresh non-root Compose HTTP smoke

corrections.cause: Rollback would remove workspace tags while leaving synthetic records
corrections.fix: Refuse down() while demo generations/tagged rows exist
corrections.prevention: Rollback regression preserving schema and data

publicationNote: Published for human review from codex/dashboard-backend, not automatically merged or publicly deployed. Exact final commit and remote ref evidence is verified after committing and stored in .git outside this self-referencing record.
